description:
Verifies the measured pilot of the decode selector holdout family and freezes its confirmation addendum with the holdout cells attached.

## Background

The pilot addendum and the holdout record of the decode selector holdout family are committed under `dev/active/ed3d490e-zen3-ldpc-frame-simd/`; the benchmark window runs the queued pilot of its non-holdout cells. The canonical freezer `dev/active/c7113c5a/survey/freeze-confirmation.py` derives the confirmation addendum from the committed pilot receipt and attaches the declared holdout cells, of which no sample exists before the confirmation. Every timed run is one line of `dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/bench-window/queue.tsv`, executed in the overnight benchmark window; nothing timed runs in a working session. The [Zen 3 measurement contract](../1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/measurement-contract.md), the [frozen protocol](../f547c394/protocol.md) with its [version-4 amendment](../f547c394/amendment-v4.md) and the [worker brief](../1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/worker-brief.md) govern every cell.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each pilot campaign is verified from its own append-only execution log with the shared campaign-log verifier: cell starts and completions equal the addendum's cell count, each cell is measured at its declared pairs, and a terminal complete record closes the log.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each receipt is committed with its input snapshots, the receipt-input snapshot check passes, and the `benchmark-acceptance` verdict recomputed from the committed receipt reproduces the committed acceptance summary byte for byte.
- [hard] REQ-03: The confirmation addendum is derived by the canonical freezer from the committed pilot receipt with the holdout cells attached, a stage-specific family description and its derivation record; margins lie strictly above one plus the pilot-derived resolution.
- [hard] REQ-04: One line for the confirmation is committed in `dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/bench-window/queue.tsv` after its addendum.
- [hard] REQ-05: The report states whether the pilot is measured or waits for a window.
title: Collect the decode selector holdout pilot
